final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT counts.ordersmark, counts.record_count, 1.0 * counts.record_count / total.total_count AS share FROM counts CROSS JOIN total), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT shares.ordersmark, shares.record_count, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.avg_share AS deviation FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10
